t: You're at 50 Cadogan Square, in the SW1X part of Kensington and Chelsea. The building was designed by Sir Ernest George, who was an English architect, and also a landscape and architectural watercolourist and etcher. So the person behind this house was as much an artist with a brush and etching needle as an architect. I don't have more specific details about the house itself, so I'll leave you to take in the square around it.
